name: screen.pitch
description: Gate the 90-second opener or one-sentence pitch for a recruiter screen. The recruiter must be able to paste one sentence into an ATS note that says W2 hire, seat, proof, next-move filter.

pasteable_sentence.instructions: A recruiter could lift one sentence from this that states who the candidate is, what seat they fit, and one proof point

names_next_move.instructions: It states what the candidate wants next in plain terms a recruiter can match to a requisition

sells_services.instructions: It pitches consulting, a company, or a services offer rather than a hire

criteria: Two or three named, numbered outcomes tied to the seat

under_90_seconds.instructions: Spoken at a normal pace this runs 90 seconds or less

rules.reason: consulting pitch in a screen opener

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
